inline_comments.comment: `# creates: cu.png` is a legacy directive from the old ASE doc/test build system (still present in `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` verbatim). It carries no meaning to sphinx-gallery and renders as a visible comment in the generated gallery page, confusing readers. Remove it entirely.

The variable `a` is too terse for a sphinx-gallery example, which serves as a learning reference. Per project conventions for gallery/tutorial scripts, use full descriptive `snake_case` names. `atoms` (or `cu_bulk`) would be clearer and consistent with the rest of the ASE codebase.

Passing `filename='cu.png'` to `bs.plot()` writes a file directly to the `examples/gallery/` directory at build time (confirmed by inspecting `BandStructurePlot.finish_plot` in `ase/spectrum/band_structure.py`). This is the old doc-build pattern carried over unchanged from `doc/ase/dft/bs.py`. In sphinx-gallery, figures should be captured automatically by the gallery engine — the `filename` argument side-steps that, produces an untracked artifact (`examples/gallery/cu.png`) that is not cleaned up by `make clean`, and could mislead users running the example locally. Drop the `filename='cu.png'` argument and add `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` + `plt.show()` so sphinx-gallery captures the figure normally and generates a gallery thumbnail.

The `emin=0` and `emax=20` values are unexplained magic numbers. A brief inline comment (e.g., `# energy window in eV; 0–20 eV covers the free-electron bands of Cu`) would help readers understand the choice.

The sphinx-gallery module docstring contains only a title and no description. Even a single sentence explaining what the example demonstrates (e.g., 'Compute and plot the free-electron band structure of bulk Cu along the GXWLGK path.') would give the gallery entry meaningful prose in the rendered HTML index.

general_comments.comment: This MR adds `examples/gallery/bs.py` but does not remove the source it was copied from. `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` is line-for-line identical to the new file (minus the docstring header), and `doc/gallery/gallery.rst` still has a 'Band-structure' section that hard-links to `../ase/dft/bs.py` and `../ase/dft/cu.png`. The migration is incomplete: the old script and the old gallery entry should be deleted in the same MR to avoid two diverging implementations of the same example.

There is no `changelog.d/` scriv fragment for this change. Per project conventions, any user-visible change (including migrating gallery content to sphinx-gallery) should be recorded in a changelog fragment under the appropriate section heading (e.g., 'Other changes' or 'Documentation') with a corresponding `:mr:` reference.
